title: Stocks Erase Post-Midterm Elections Rally, Dragged Down by Tech
summary: The S&P 500 slumped to its worst daily decline since April 2025 and the tech-heavy Nasdaq entered correction territory, as investors fretted about the durability of the A.I. build-out.
